dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, continuous 2D geometric narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward a sharp posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Distinct bilateral indentation at the cervical region (neck); otherwise smooth convex lateral margins.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white; median pixel values represent a fully depigmented dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; trace grey shading localized to the cervical fold and lower right lateral margin.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast boundary along the mid-body margins; diffuse transition at the posterior peduncle due to water submersion.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast, dark semi-circular aperture (blowhole) on the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Transverse indentation at the cervical region and a faint longitudinal ridge along the posterior dorsal axis.
